content.rendered:
AV AND TECHNICAL SUPPORT

We offer 2 main packages for your AV & Technical needs for your event. The STANDARD PACKAGE and The TECHNICAL PACKAGE plus there are lots of OPTIONAL EXTRAS ensuring your event has everything it needs.

STANDARD PACKAGE INCLUDED IN YOUR DDR RATE

Our standard AV Package in with our DDR Rates includes an HD Projector and Screen or Large TV Screen.  This comes with an HDMI link to connect with your devices. The rooms come with standard lighting and all the items listed in our DDR rate information above.

This option is perfect for smaller meetings, training sessions, board meetings etc and there additional options available listed below. For larger conferences to be held in The Birchley Suite we recommend considering the TECHNICAL PACKAGE below.

THE TECHNICAL PACKAGE

For peace of mind and the occasions where you need a lot more: large conferences, product launches, catwalk fashion shows, consider The Technical Package. It comes complete with our extremely experienced technician who can run everything for you. It certainly helps takes any stress from you and means you don’t have to organise separate AV companies. There are a lot of optional extras available but quite a bit of budget can be saved when booking this package as a lot is included in The Technical Package. If you would like more information on either packages, please call the team on 01676 540333 or email sales@heartofengland.co.uk

INCLUDED IN THE TECHNICAL PACKAGE

  • Main projector & screen (HDMI link for your laptop)
  • PA system with 1 x radio microphone
  • Truss Lectern
  • PC running office 365
  • Mastercue slide clicker
  • Technician (8hr event day)
  • White room wash plus Lighting desk with full control of house lighting
  • Audio / Video replay system with music streaming
  • Visual switcher

OPTIONAL EXTRAS

  • PA system with 1 x radio microphone (also allows for PC sound)
  • Additional radio microphones 3 Handhelds / 6 lapel in stock
  • Truss Lectern
  • PC running office 365
  • Mastercue slide clicker
  • Technician (8hr event day)
  • Lighting desk with full control of house lighting *
  • Audio / Video replay system with music streaming *
  • Visual switcher *
  • On-stage cue monitor (duplicate image)
  • Side screens x 2 (duplicate images)
  • Side screens x 4 (duplicate images)
  • Staging 2m x 1m sections - 12 in stock
  • Use of moving heads (8 x Mac700p / 4 x Mac700w)
  • Full colour laser system with Pangolin controller
  • Haze machine
  • HD camera image to side screens
  • 50” LED monitor on wheeled stand with HDMI or USB input 3 in stock
  • Duramax flipchart stand with pad and pens 10 in stock
  • All items marked with a '*' are only available with a technician.
